async function save(x) {}
async function next(c) {
	return null;
}
async function u1(n) {
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++, await save(i)) {}
}
async function u2(n) {
	let i = 0;
	for (; i < n; await save(i), i++) {}
}
async function u3(n) {
	for (var i = 0, j = 0; i < n; await save(i + j), i++) {}
}
async function u4(n) {
	for (let i = 0, j = 0, k = 0; i < n; await save(i + j + k), i++) {}
}
async function u5(first) {
	for (
		let cursor = first, seen = 0;
		cursor;
		cursor = await next(cursor), seen++
	) {
		use(cursor, seen);
	}
}
async function u6(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++, await save(i)) {
		use(items[i]);
	}
}
function use() {}
